name: Mountainbike-Höhenrunde Ischgl
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The **Mountain Bike Round Trip Ischgl** is one of the most stunning e-bike tours in the Alps. The route covers 40 kilometers through the Silvretta region, passing by turquoise mountain lakes and crossing passes reaching over 2,500 meters in elevation. E-bike rental is included. A must for every ambitious cyclist.
